authorization.decision: record the owner's two affirmations, adopt and apply protocol 2.0.0, and appoint the custodian
authorization.instrument: the owner's written Stage 2ZN instruction and its two quoted affirmations of 2026-11-15
authorization.scope: docs/research/stage2zn/ records and manifest, plus the exact protocol section 8.2 text change the adoption authorizes; hashing and Git operations; no data access; no Gate 2; no candidate substitution; no strategy design

deliverables.role: The owner's verbatim adopting statement, its recorded UTC date 2026-11-15, the amendment path/hash/version 2.0.0, the V-1, V-2, manifest, Y-1, and Y-2 acknowledgements, the protocol before/after hashes, the applied text change, and what the adoption does not do

The owner's verbatim self-appointment of Hossein Akbari as custodian, the conditional-on-adoption dependency (met), the disclosed owner/custodian overlap, every preserved restriction, and the outstanding independent Gate 4 auditor dependency

Independent validation of the adoption, the applied protocol change, the custodian appointment, the recomputed hashes, the predecessor manifest checks, the NOT VERIFIED list, and the zero-access record
The adopted protocol text, version 2.0.0: section 8.2's final sentence replaced, the new section 8.2.1 clauses A-1 to A-5 inserted, and the header version line assigned

findings.summary: the protocol required semantic versions and a manifest per version but carried no version string
findings.treatment: resolved by this adoption: the protocol is assigned version 2.0.0 as the first versioned form, with no prior 1.x asserted

findings.summary: the amendment could not itself edit section 8.2, because section 10.3 forbids changing a frozen artifact before adoption
findings.treatment: resolved by this adoption: the section 8.2 text change was authorized by the adopting statement and applied as a separate step

findings.summary: under R-b the four disclosed Stage 2ZC boundary open_time inspections are reserved contact
findings.treatment: preserved as a pre-amendment deviation; neither grandfathered nor retroactively legalized

findings.summary: the Stage 2ZC full-file SHA-256 digests also touched reserved bytes and are reserved contact under R-b
findings.treatment: preserved as a pre-amendment deviation; computational values remain as file identity; no analyst reproducibility claimed; not recomputed in this stage

findings.summary: Stage 2ZG cites packet section 7 issue I-2 for Q-1, but the packet contains no Q-1, no I-2, and no issue list in section 7
findings.treatment: carried unchanged; Q-1 recorded strictly as a confirmation of the 26 bp label

findings.summary: 2ZD-4 has five fields in the packet and seven in the accepted proposal
findings.treatment: carried unchanged; disclosed as a superset

findings.summary: the 90-day embargo is derived from 540 x 4h and its agreement is exact but contingent
findings.treatment: carried unchanged; the registration should record the derivation, not the number

findings.summary: protocol section 10.4 permits a pre-registered interpretation to resolve an ambiguity, so R-b is the stricter route rather than the only route
10,000 resamples and seed 20240101 appear in one prior recommendation only
findings.treatment: carried unchanged; disclosed as a comparability and reproducibility choice

findings.summary: no candidate specification contains an exit or holding rule, so dependence adequacy and embargo sufficiency stay conditional
findings.treatment: carried unchanged; an unresolved Gate 2 registration input distinct from the missing hypothesis

findings.summary: the owner is both owner and custodian, so the Gate 4 audit must be performed by someone other than the custodian, and no such independent auditor exists yet
findings.treatment: recorded as an outstanding operational dependency; no auditor appointed or invented

hashing_procedure: SHA256 over the UTF-8 canonical JSON encoding (json.dumps, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False) of this object with the self_hash field removed. The file is written with indent=2, sort_keys=True and a trailing newline.
nature: Owner affirmation recording, one authorized protocol text change, and one custodian appointment. The Stage 2ZI amendment is adopted as protocol version 2.0.0; section 8.2's final sentence is replaced and section 8.2.1 (A-1 to A-5) is inserted; Hossein Akbari is appointed owner-custodian under the custodian instrument. No reserved byte read, streamed, decoded, or hashed; no dataset file opened; no census, backtest, simulation, parameter fit, strategy experiment, cost or liquidity measurement, quote sampling, venue contact, order, or real-capital sizing. No predecessor artifact modified other than the authorized protocol change; no gate moved.
no_performance_claim: No expected return, profitability, achievable income, execution-feasibility, or real-capital claim is made. Both candidates remain at FEASIBILITY FAIL - INSUFFICIENT OPPORTUNITIES; no hypothesis is registered; S-1 supports no frequency or profitability claim and does not relax any feasibility threshold; 26 bp and the E-2 planning values remain unmeasured assumptions and 26 bp is not a measured Nobitex cost.
open_items: a hypothesis, which C-N withholds and without which Gate 2 cannot be registered at all
a registered exit and holding policy, which becomes decisive once a hypothesis is named
an independent Gate 4 auditor, who must not be the custodian and must have no prior involvement in design or implementation
the custodian's digest run, which waits for Gate 2 registration and cannot begin under C-N
an answer to T-5 on the 250 target
the planning DE and p_exec brackets at registration under E-2
whether Y-1 and Y-2 affect the admissibility of any Stage 2ZC-derived result (owner question, informed by the Gate 4 audit)

predecessor_manifest_verification.procedure: each predecessor manifest read and its self_hash recomputed with the same canonical procedure

repository.working_tree_at_manifest_creation: contains only the new Stage 2ZN artifacts and the authorized protocol change

status_after_stage.Y-1_Y-2: recorded pre-amendment deviations; neither grandfathered nor retroactively legalized
status_after_stage.candidates: both FEASIBILITY FAIL - INSUFFICIENT OPPORTUNITIES, frozen at v2.0.0
status_after_stage.custodian: Hossein Akbari (owner-custodian); overlap disclosed; independent Gate 4 auditor still outstanding
